get.description: Returns 200 when the Croniq API process is alive.
Checks the configured job persistence provider for reachability.
Returns the current caller context (tenant, environment, scopes) after authentication.

post.description: Creates or updates a tenant record for the provided tenantId.

get.description: Returns tenant metadata. Use state=all to include inactive tenants.
Returns tenant metadata for the provided tenant identifier.

delete.description: Marks the tenant as inactive without deleting historical data.

get.description: Returns all job definitions for the tenant/environment scope.

post.description: Creates or updates the job definition for the specified job key.

get.description: Returns the job definition for the specified job key.

delete.description: Deletes the job definition and associated triggers within the tenant/environment scope.

get.description: Returns execution summaries for the tenant/environment scope with optional filters.
Returns metadata for a single execution in the tenant/environment scope.

post.description: Registers a Cron-based trigger for the specified tenant-scoped job key.

get.description: Returns all persisted schedules for the tenant/environment scope, optionally filtered by job key.
Returns the persisted schedule metadata for the requested trigger identifier.

delete.description: Deletes the persisted trigger for the tenant/environment scope.

get.description: Returns all calendar definitions for the tenant/environment scope.

post.description: Creates or updates a calendar definition for the tenant/environment scope.

get.description: Returns the calendar definition for the requested calendar id.

delete.description: Deletes the calendar definition for the tenant/environment scope.

get.description: Enumerates failed trigger executions for investigation or replay.

post.description: Re-dispatches a failed trigger execution via the job execution pipeline.

get.description: Returns an aggregated forecast for schedule executions within the requested window.
Returns all webhook endpoints for the specified tenant/environment scope.

post.description: Registers a webhook endpoint for a tenant/environment, optionally overriding rate limits and signatures.

get.description: Returns the webhook defaults/capabilities for the tenant/environment scope.

delete.description: Removes a webhook endpoint and its metadata for the tenant/environment scope.

post.description: Schedules or immediately rotates a webhook secret and returns the new plaintext.

get.description: Returns the CIDR allow-list associated with a webhook endpoint.

post.description: Adds a CIDR block to the allow-list for the webhook endpoint.

delete.description: Removes a CIDR allow-list entry from the webhook endpoint.

get.description: Returns endpoint changefeed events for a webhook in the tenant/environment scope.

post.description: Triggers a webhook endpoint through the job execution pipeline.

get.description: Enumerates failed webhook deliveries for investigation or replay.

post.description: Re-dispatches a failed webhook payload via the job execution pipeline.
Marks a webhook dead letter as resolved without replaying it.
Stores a failure update for a webhook dead letter without replaying it.

get.description: Returns all registered API clients for the tenant, optionally filtered by environment.

post.description: Creates a tenant-scoped API client or updates metadata/scopes when the client already exists.

delete.description: Deletes the API client metadata and revokes any associated API keys.

get.description: Returns metadata about a tenant-scoped API client, including scopes and activity flags.

post.description: Creates a new API key for the specified tenant client and returns the plaintext once.
Revokes an existing API key and returns a fresh secret for the same client.

delete.description: Immediately revokes an API key for the tenant.

post.description: Mints a Croniq-signed bearer token for the specified client (tenant-level variant).
Same payload as the tenant route but infers the clientId from the path.
Authenticates a username/password and issues access + refresh tokens. Tenant must be provided via tenantId.
Rotates the refresh token and returns a new access token.
Revokes the provided refresh token.
Changes the password for the currently authenticated password user. Requires a valid access token.

get.description: Streams NDJSON execution logs for a tenant-scoped execution after authorizing tenant scope.

post.description: Executes a job immediately or schedules a one-off run when DelaySeconds is provided.
Claims due trigger leases for execution (HTTP long-poll style).
Renews an existing trigger lease for a running work item.
Acknowledges work completion and releases the trigger lease.
Pushes execution-scoped log/events for a running work item.
Records a runner heartbeat to track availability.

get.description: Lists active runners for the tenant/environment.

post.description: Records a worker host heartbeat to track availability.

get.description: Lists active worker hosts for the tenant/environment.
